@copilot+claude-opus-4.6 InMemoryStrategy  是否应该在 memory driver 中定义。还有 注册 analytics 服务是否也应该在service-analytics, 而不是 memory driver ?

> @copilot+claude-opus-4.6 InMemoryStrategy  是否应该在 memory driver 中定义。还有 注册 analytics 服务是否也应该在service-analytics, 而不是 memory driver ?

Agreed on both points. In `ac2177b`:

1. **InMemoryStrategy moved to driver-memory** — `packages/plugins/driver-memory/src/in-memory-strategy.ts`, exported from the driver-memory index. The strategy contract types (`AnalyticsStrategy`, `StrategyContext`, `DriverCapabilities`) are now defined in `@objectstack/spec/contracts/analytics-service.ts` following Protocol First principle.

2. **Analytics service registration stays in service-analytics** — this was already the case (`plugin.ts` does `ctx.registerService('analytics', ...)` / `ctx.replaceService`). The `AnalyticsService` now uses an internal `FallbackDelegateStrategy` (not exported) that auto-activates when `fallbackService` is configured, so it no longer depends on `InMemoryStrategy` from driver-memory.
